_comment: Structural-similarity regions for dxpker-sky-v1. IP-sensitive placeholder areas (real-person portraits, brand-specific chess disc, branded category icons) are excluded (weight=0) because the clone uses generic abstract SVG which will never pixel-match real photos / brand designs — they are not the target of structural similarity. The measured score is the **non-IP structural similarity**: header / footer / nav / layout chrome.

segments.name: hero-frame
segments.note: EXCLUDED: hero placeholder (IP-sensitive center, abstract SVG)

segments.note: EXCLUDED: 4 category icons (branded SVG) — extended to cover icon position differences
